package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for multiple_error_envelope_shapes_same_api_module: Endpoints in the same API surface that serialize unrelated error payload structures.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type ErrorV1 struct {
	Message string `json:"message"`
	Code    int    `json:"code"`
}

type ErrorV2 struct {
	Error      string `json:"error"`
	StatusCode int    `json:"status_code"`
	Details    string `json:"details"`
}

func GetUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(ErrorV1{
		Message: "user not found",
		Code:    404,
	})
}

func CreateUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(ErrorV2{
		Error:      "validation failed",
		StatusCode: 400,
		Details:    "username is required",
	})
}
